_comment: Tracks whether each phase's numbers come from your own executed runs or
from the worked template shipped with this toolkit.
While any value below is false, the report prints a Provenance and
Declaration notice on page 1. Run the phase, replace the numbers in the
matching CSV with what you actually measured, set the flag to true, and
rebuild - the notice shrinks to list only what is still outstanding, and
disappears entirely when everything is true.
Do not set a flag to true without doing the run. The notice existing is
far better than a claim that cannot be supported.
